name: adhd-pr-reviewer
title_zh: 竖屏脑腐风 PR 评审视频，自动配字幕旁白还能回贴
tagline_zh: 把代码评审变成能刷的短视频：前端演示+游戏画面+大字幕+AI旁白。
tagline_en: Turn code review into scrollable shorts: frontend demo, gameplay, captions, AI voiceover, and optional comment.
desc_en: Create an ADHD PR review video: a vertical PR video with a frontend demo, brainrot gameplay, word captions, narration, and an optional GitHub PR comment.
why_zh: 它把 PR 评审从文字拉回眼球经济：用脑腐节奏包装技术内容，让不看文档的同事也能三秒进入状态。
why_en: It hijacks the brainrot format to make PR reviews watchable — packaging technical diffs into dopamine-friendly verticals, then.
limit_zh: 只生成视频文件和可选评论草稿，不负责发布；需要你自备录屏素材或前端 demo 链接；旁白用系统 TTS，音色不拟人。
limit_en: Outputs video + optional comment draft only; you supply screen recordings or demo URL; uses system TTS (robotic voice); comment posts only after.
title_en: Vertical brainrot PR review video with captions & narration
